verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax records transactions through the Tax Transactions API and offers itemized exports with a line-item tax breakdown for every transaction, which covers the core of an audit trail. It also returns a taxability_reason explaining each tax result and ties products to rates through product tax codes, including a preset fallback code. The evidence does not show that the resolved customer address (including IP geolocation) or the specific jurisdiction rules applied are kept with each transaction or included in exports. Missing for 10: evidence that the address resolution and rule details are retained per transaction, confirmation that exports include the product tax code and taxability reason, a documented retention period, and independent or hands-on confirmation of audit reconstruction.
